tools.name: adjust_audio_levels

tools.name: apply_derived_dialogue_sequence_uxp

tools.name: execute_extendscript
tools.description: Execute custom ExtendScript code in Premiere Pro. The code runs inside an IIFE with helper functions available. IMPORTANT: You MUST write ES3 syntax (var instead of let/const, no arrow functions, no template literals, no destructuring). Available helpers (auto-prepended): - __ticksToSeconds(ticks) / __secondsToTicks(seconds) — time conversion - __ticksToTimecode(ticks, fps) — timecode string - __findSequence(idOrName) — find sequence by name or ID - __findProjectItem(nodeIdOrName) — find project item recursively - __findClip(nodeId) — find clip in active sequence, returns {clip, trackIndex, clipIndex, trackType} - __getAllClips(seq) — get all clips in a sequence - __result(data) — return success with data (MUST call this or __error) - __error(msg) — return error message - TICKS_PER_SECOND — constant 254016000000 - app.enableQE() — enable QE DOM access Your code MUST end with: return __result({...}) or return __error("message") Example: Set opacity to 50% on all video clips var seq = app.project.activeSequence; if (!seq) return __error("No active sequence"); var count = 0; for (var t = 0; t < seq.videoTracks.numTracks; t++) { var track = seq.videoTracks[t]; for (var c = 0; c < track.clips.numItems; c++) { var clip = track.clips[c]; for (var i = 0; i < clip.components.numItems; i++) { var comp = clip.components[i]; if (comp.displayName === "Opacity") { for (var p = 0; p < comp.properties.numItems; p++) { if (comp.properties[p].displayName === "Opacity") { comp.properties[p].setValue(50, true); count++; } } } } } } return __result({updated: count});

tools.description: Get a comprehensive overview of the project. Use include_bin_tree false or sequence_offset/sequence_limit for a bounded response on large projects.

tools.name: get_full_sequence_info
tools.description: Get exhaustive information about a sequence: settings, all tracks with lock/mute/target state, all clips with positions/effects/speed/enabled state, all markers, transitions, in/out points, and work area.

tools.name: get_graphics_white_luminance
tools.description: Get the graphics white luminance value (HDR setting) for the project

tools.name: get_insertion_bin
tools.description: Get the current target bin for new imports (the bin that is currently focused in the Project panel)

tools.name: get_item_info
tools.description: Get detailed type info about a project item (is it a sequence, multicam, merged clip, etc.)

tools.name: get_keyframes
tools.description: Get all keyframes for a specific effect property on a clip

tools.name: get_linked_items
tools.description: Get all clips in the sequence that are linked to the same source as a given clip

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for a project item. Disable either XML payload when a bounded identity/path response is sufficient.

tools.name: get_mogrt_component
tools.description: Get MOGRT (Motion Graphics Template) component parameters from a clip

tools.name: get_next_edit_point
tools.modes: direction: next, previous; track_type: video, audio, both
tools.description: Find the next or previous edit point (clip boundary) from the playhead position.

tools.name: get_offline_media
tools.description: Find all offline/missing media in the project with their expected file paths. Essential for diagnosing broken links.

tools.name: get_playhead_position
tools.description: Get the current playhead (CTI) position in the active sequence

tools.name: get_premiere_state
tools.description: Get a comprehensive snapshot of the current Premiere Pro state: project info, active sequence, playhead position, selected clips, and available sequences. The best first call to understand the current context.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Get information about the currently open Premiere Pro project

tools.name: get_project_item_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a project item (media file in the project panel): media path, resolution, duration, frame rate, codec info, metadata, color label, offline status, in/out points, and proxy status.

tools.name: get_project_panel_metadata
tools.description: Get the current project panel metadata/column configuration as XML

tools.name: get_project_scratch_disks
tools.description: Get the current scratch disk paths for the project.

tools.name: get_qe_clip_info
tools.description: Get QE DOM information about a clip, including properties not available through the standard API.

tools.name: get_render_queue_status
tools.description: Report the Adobe Media Encoder queue running state, or fail closed with a named capability error when this Premiere build exposes no queue-status method on app.encoder.

tools.name: get_selected_clips
tools.description: Get the currently selected clips in the active sequence

tools.name: get_sequence_count
tools.description: Get the total number of sequences in the project.

tools.name: get_sequence_in_out_points
tools.description: Get the current sequence in and out points

tools.name: get_sequence_markers_by_type
tools.modes: marker_type: Comment, Chapter, Segmentation, WebLink, FlashCuePoint
tools.description: Get all markers of a specific type (comment, chapter, web link, etc.) from a sequence.

tools.name: get_sequence_settings
tools.description: Get the settings (resolution, frame rate, etc.) of a sequence

tools.name: get_sequence_structure
tools.description: Get a complete structural overview of the active sequence: all tracks, all clips with positions, gaps, and clip metadata. Essential for understanding timeline state before making edits.

tools.name: get_source_monitor_info
tools.description: Get information about the clip currently loaded in the Source Monitor.

tools.name: get_source_monitor_position
tools.description: Get the current time indicator position in the Source Monitor

tools.name: get_target_tracks
tools.description: Get which tracks are currently targeted for editing.

tools.name: get_timeline_gaps
tools.description: Find all gaps (empty spaces) on the timeline between clips. Useful for identifying where content is missing or where clips can be tightened.

tools.name: get_timeline_summary
tools.description: Get a human-readable summary of the timeline: total duration, clip count per track, total gaps, coverage percentage, used media files, effect usage, and marker overview. Great for a quick understanding of sequence state.

tools.name: get_total_clip_count
tools.description: Get the total number of clips across all tracks in the active sequence.

tools.name: get_track_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific track: name, clip count, muted, locked, targeted, and list of all clips.

tools.name: get_transcript_languages_uxp
tools.description: List transcription languages supported by the connected Premiere 26.3+ host.

tools.name: get_unused_media
tools.description: Find all project items that are NOT used in any sequence. Useful for cleaning up projects.

tools.name: get_used_media_report
tools.description: Get a report of all media files used in a sequence: which source files are used, how many times each appears, on which tracks, and whether any sources are offline.

tools.name: get_uxp_capabilities
tools.description: Report the authenticated local UXP bridge connection and the capabilities advertised by the connected Premiere host.

tools.name: get_uxp_state
tools.description: Read the active project, sequence, and playhead state through the connected Premiere UXP bridge.

tools.name: get_uxp_workspace_access
tools.description: Report whether the Premiere panel has an operator-approved persistent workspace folder. The native path and persistent token are never returned.

tools.name: get_value_at_time
tools.description: Get the interpolated value of an effect property at a specific time

tools.name: get_version_info
tools.description: Get Premiere Pro version and build information.

tools.name: get_work_area
tools.description: Get the current work area in and out points

tools.name: get_workspaces
tools.description: List all available workspace layouts in Premiere Pro

tools.name: get_xmp_metadata
tools.description: Get the raw XMP metadata for a project item (includes EXIF, IPTC, Dublin Core, etc.)

tools.name: has_proxy
tools.description: Check if a project item has a proxy attached

tools.name: has_transcript_uxp
tools.description: Check whether a source media clip has a transcript, preferring Premiere 26.3's documented native API when available.

tools.name: import_ae_comps
tools.description: Import After Effects compositions from an .aep file, failing closed when the file does not exist or when the target bin gains no items.

tools.name: import_edl
tools.description: Unavailable by design: CMX 3600 EDL import opens Premiere UI that can block the CEP bridge. No import is attempted; convert the EDL to FCP7 XML and use import_fcp_xml for unattended interchange.

tools.name: import_fcp_xml
tools.description: Open a Final Cut Pro XML file as a new Premiere project. app.openFCPXML(path, projPath) requires a destination project path; it does not merge the XML into the currently open project.

tools.name: import_folder
tools.description: Import an entire folder of media into the project

tools.name: import_image_sequence
tools.description: Import a numbered image sequence as a single video clip.

tools.name: import_media
tools.description: Import media files into the project

tools.name: import_mogrt
tools.description: Import a Motion Graphics Template (.mogrt) file and add it to the timeline

tools.name: import_mogrt_from_library
tools.description: Import a MOGRT from a named Adobe Creative Cloud Library.

tools.name: import_project_media_uxp
tools.description: Import workspace-contained media files, sequences, or After Effects compositions through documented Project APIs with post-state evidence.

tools.name: import_sequences
tools.description: Import sequences from another Premiere Pro project file

tools.name: import_transcript_uxp
tools.description: Replace one source media clip's native transcript JSON through documented Premiere 26.3+ UXP APIs. Use project_guid and transcript_revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp, or project_guid plus a null expected_transcript_revision from has_transcript_uxp for an untranscribed clip. This destructive import requires explicit confirmation and an operation_id, serializes competing imports for the same project item, runs one undoable transaction, and reports exact bounded export SHA-256 readback rather than claiming a licensed-host result.

tools.name: insert_from_source
tools.description: Insert the clip from the Source Monitor at the playhead position (insert edit — shifts existing clips).

tools.name: inspect_after_effects_render_templates
tools.description: Read available render and output-module template names from the first existing After Effects render-queue item. It never queues or renders a composition.

tools.name: inspect_after_effects_template_source
tools.description: Inspect a saved After Effects source composition for MOGRT-relevant dimensions, duration, text fonts, layer-source kinds, and Essential Graphics controller names when the host exposes the AE 16.1+ readback API. It never creates a composition or returns asset paths.

tools.name: inspect_caption_tracks_uxp
tools.description: Inventory native caption tracks on the active sequence through documented Premiere UXP APIs. Returns track identity, name, mute state, and item count only; it does not inspect cue text, timing, rendered appearance, or caption correctness.

tools.name: inspect_cmx3600_edl
tools.description: Parse a local CMX 3600 EDL into bounded event, reel, track, transition, and timecode facts without importing it into Premiere.

tools.name: inspect_dom_object
tools.description: Inspect a Premiere Pro DOM object and list its properties, methods, and values. Useful for exploring the API and debugging. Examples: - "app.project" → project properties - "app.project.activeSequence" → sequence properties - "app.project.activeSequence.videoTracks[0].clips[0]" → first clip on V1 - "app.project.activeSequence.videoTracks[0].clips[0].components[0]" → first component of a clip

tools.name: inspect_edit_readiness
tools.description: Audit the active sequence in one read-only bridge request for empty timelines, primary-track gaps, disabled clips, muted tracks, and excessive Motion scale. Structural diagnostics only; it cannot judge story, framing, sound, or final delivery.

tools.name: inspect_effect_parameter_catalog_uxp
tools.description: Inspect the bounded native descriptor catalog for one effect component on one active-sequence audio or video clip. The returned parameter index and display name can be used with existing parameter automation. It returns only animation capability/state, never raw parameter values (including Color or PointF), media paths, rendered pixels, or playback results. The bridge reads the complete catalog twice and rejects a changed project, active sequence, component identity, or parameter descriptor set.

tools.name: inspect_fcpxml_interchange
tools.description: Inspect a local FCPXML document's root version, sequence/clip counts, bounded asset declarations, and text-only parser warnings before deliberate Premiere import.

tools.name: inspect_film_editorial_workflow
tools.description: Validate a revision-bound film editorial manifest against captured source and timeline identities. Build complete declared coverage review groups, independent picture/audio preferences, screening-note exceptions, story dependencies, VFX state, change impact and a department turnover manifest. Local inspection only: no host edits, exports, automatic creative decisions or verified host claims.

tools.name: inspect_frame_alignment_uxp
tools.description: Use Premiere's documented native TickTime and FrameRate APIs to either align one bounded requested time down or to the nearest frame boundary, or construct the exact TickTime for one frame count. This is read-only, uses only caller-owned inputs, and returns native seconds and tick-string readback; it does not inspect a sequence, infer its frame rate, change Premiere, or prove a licensed host.

tools.name: inspect_installed_mogrt_directory_uxp
tools.description: Inspect whether Premiere exposes its documented installed MOGRT directory. The native path is redacted unless include_path is explicitly true. This tool never enumerates the directory, reads its files, imports a template, or changes Premiere; a returned path is not proof that templates are usable or compatible.

tools.name: inspect_media_streams
tools.description: Inspect a local media file with ffprobe and return container, stream, codec, time-base, channel, and chapter metadata. Read-only and independent of Premiere.

tools.name: inspect_mogrt_library
tools.description: List bounded top-level template names and version directories in an existing workspace-contained local MOGRT library. It never reads MOGRT contents or changes the library.

tools.name: inspect_premiere_environment_uxp
tools.description: Inspect After Effects interoperability and the active Premiere project's current and supported graphics-white luminance values through documented read-only UXP APIs.

tools.name: inspect_premiere_events_uxp
tools.description: List or briefly wait for bounded, redacted Premiere host-event receipts without polling the complete project state. Compatible hosts can also emit timeline.snap.* receipts plus operation.clip.extend.reached and coalesced operation.effect.drag.over receipts for documented root notifications; raw event payloads are never returned.

tools.name: inspect_project_insertion_bin_uxp
tools.description: Read the current Project-panel insertion bin through documented Premiere UXP APIs. Returns only the active-project GUID and insertion-bin ID, name, and type; it does not traverse project folders, reveal media paths, or change Premiere. The panel target is read twice and the command rejects a project or target change while snapshotting.

tools.name: inspect_project_item_av_metadata
tools.description: Inspect a project item's documented effective/original color space, LUT IDs, available color-space overrides, and audio channel shape.

tools.name: inspect_project_panel_metadata_uxp
tools.description: Read bounded native Project-panel metadata: either the active project's panel schema or one media item's column metadata. This is read-only; it neither creates metadata schema fields nor writes Project-panel state.

tools.name: inspect_project_recovery
tools.description: Read-only recovery inspection: diagnose the active project path and list adjacent Premiere Auto-Save project candidates without opening, copying, or restoring anything.

tools.name: inspect_project_selection_uxp
tools.description: List Premiere Project-panel views or inspect up to 256 selected project items without traversing the complete project tree.

tools.name: inspect_project_tree_uxp
tools.description: Read a bounded, depth-limited native Project-panel tree rooted at the active project. Returns stable IDs, names, types, parent IDs, bin state, and optional color-label indexes only; it never returns media paths, metadata, or rendered media.

tools.name: inspect_project_uxp
tools.description: Read a compact, revisioned project and sequence snapshot through documented Premiere UXP APIs.

tools.name: inspect_sequence_av_settings
tools.description: Inspect documented audio, tone-mapping, linear-compositing, bit-depth, render-quality, and display settings for the active sequence.

tools.name: inspect_sequence_review_report
tools.description: Build one read-only sequence handoff report with timeline structure, primary-track gaps, disabled clips, muted tracks, marker timing, and offline-source evidence. Media paths are never returned; marker comments require an explicit opt-in. It does not prove rendered pixels, audio quality, caption correctness, rights, or editorial approval.

tools.name: inspect_sequence_structure_uxp
tools.description: Read a bounded native UXP timeline structure for one sequence: selected video and/or audio tracks with clip timing and state. Opt in to source Project-item IDs only when needed, then optionally classify those sources as sequence, merged, multicam, or offline or return their documented broad content category (any, sequence, or media); a further opt-in returns only a nested source sequence GUID when that classification is exactly sequence. No Project-panel metadata, names, type codes, paths, nested timeline content, or traversal are read. track_counts contains only the requested media types, never a zero placeholder for an unqueried type. The response is capped at 64 tracks and 512 items, omits components, rendered pixels, audio analysis, and caption cues, and is not a locked cross-object snapshot or proof of playback or editorial correctness.

tools.name: inspect_sequence_timing_by_guid_uxp
tools.description: Read one known sequence's bounded native timing and backing Project-item identity, including a non-active sequence without activating it. It resolves the exact GUID through the documented Project API, requires a matching project/sequence identity after the asynchronous reads, and rejects any timing change between complete first and final snapshots. It does not modify Premiere, prove an atomic host snapshot, or validate a licensed host.

tools.name: inspect_sequence_timing_uxp
tools.description: Read the active sequence's native frame size, timebase, audio/video time-display codes, and backing Project-item identity. The command rejects malformed host values or a final active-sequence mismatch; it does not modify Premiere, claim a locked snapshot, or detect a transient switch that returns to the same active sequence.

tools.name: inspect_source_media_provenance_uxp
tools.description: Read selected documented source-media provenance paths for one explicit media-backed Project item. At least one explicit include flag is required before either native path is queried or returned. The command resolves the requested item through a bounded Project-item tree twice and rejects a changed project, target item, or requested path; it does not enumerate folders in its response, access the filesystem, inspect media contents or metadata, validate a path's existence, modify Premiere, prove an atomic snapshot, origin lineage, rights, persistence, or licensed-host behavior.

tools.name: inspect_source_proxy_uxp
tools.description: Read documented proxy-readiness state for one explicit media-backed Project item. Proxy attachment state, offline state, and native capability booleans are read twice through a bounded Project-item tree; a native proxy path is queried and returned only when include_proxy_path is true and a proxy is reported attached. The command rejects changed project, target, or selected proxy state. It does not enumerate folders in its response, does not access the filesystem, validate a path's existence, inspect media contents, attach or relink proxy media, modify Premiere, prove an atomic snapshot, proxy compatibility, playback, persistence, Undo, or licensed-host behavior.

tools.name: inspect_stabilizer_status
tools.description: Read Warp Stabilizer presence, exposed status properties, and conservative analysis state for one clip or every video clip in the active sequence. Read-only: unknown or localized host values remain unknown rather than being reported as solved.

tools.name: inspect_track_item_identity_uxp
tools.description: Inspect one active-sequence clip's native match name, item type, media UUID, reported track index, and selection state through documented UXP APIs. It rechecks the active sequence identity before returning and does not expose media paths, effect parameters, or rendered output.

tools.name: inspect_unique_object_identity_uxp
tools.description: Read the opaque documented Premiere unique serializable identity for exactly one existing project item or sequence, without changing the project. Select exactly one locator. The bridge independently resolves and reads the target twice, rejecting an active-project, locator, or unique-identity change rather than returning a mixed snapshot. It does not expose paths, metadata, content, timeline placement, editability, rendering, playback, persistence guarantees, or a licensed-host result.

tools.name: inspect_video_transition_uxp
tools.description: Read one bounded native video-transition target, including the active sequence GUID, source item ID, timeline edges, and presence at one requested edge. Copy this snapshot unchanged into add_video_transition_uxp or remove_video_transition_uxp.

tools.name: invert_selection
tools.description: Invert the current clip selection in the active sequence (selected become deselected and vice versa).

tools.name: is_work_area_enabled
tools.description: Check whether the work area bar is enabled on the active sequence

tools.name: lift_selection
tools.description: Lift (remove without closing gap) the content between sequence in/out points or selected clips.

tools.name: lift_selection_uxp
tools.description: Lift the current timeline selection through Premiere's documented UXP SequenceEditor. This removes selected items without ripple in one undoable transaction; transaction acceptance is not a timeline readback.

tools.name: link_selection
tools.description: Link the currently selected video and audio clips in the active sequence

tools.name: list_available_audio_effects
tools.description: List all available audio effects in Premiere Pro. Uses QE DOM.

tools.name: list_available_audio_transitions
tools.description: List all available audio transitions. Uses QE DOM and reports an unavailable or empty legacy catalog as an error rather than an assumed usable list.

tools.name: list_available_effects
tools.description: List available video effects in Premiere Pro. Uses the full QE catalog when exposed; otherwise returns a verified, explicitly partial set of common effects resolved by exact name.

tools.name: list_available_transitions
tools.description: List all available video transitions. Uses QE DOM. Returns a hint set on PPro 2026 where the transition registry list is empty even though by-name lookup works.

tools.name: list_clip_effects
tools.description: List all effects/components on a clip with their properties and current values. Essential for debugging effect issues.

tools.name: list_markers
tools.description: List all markers on the active sequence or a specific clip

tools.name: list_markers_uxp
tools.description: List Premiere markers with stable 26.3+ GUIDs from the active sequence or one source media clip. Web-link URLs/frame targets and raw marker RGBA components are returned only with explicit opt-in; URLs can contain sensitive query data, and color components are host values without a color-profile or rendered-appearance claim.

tools.name: list_project_items
tools.description: List all items in the project panel (clips, bins, sequences)

tools.name: list_sequence_tracks
tools.description: List all tracks (video and audio) in a sequence

tools.name: list_sequences
tools.description: List all sequences in the project

tools.name: list_video_transitions_uxp
tools.description: List the installed native video-transition match names from the connected Premiere UXP host.

tools.name: lock_track
tools.description: Lock or unlock a video track

tools.name: maintain_media_health_uxp
tools.description: Inspect up to 64 source media items, refresh them serially, transactionally set them offline, or find project items matching an approved media path. Native paths are redacted unless explicitly requested; opt-in media timing is read-only, bounded, and runtime-compatible.

tools.name: make_split_edit_uxp
tools.description: Create an undoable J-cut or L-cut by extending one aligned 1x audio item while preserving source sync, with atomic UXP actions and edge/source readback.

tools.name: manage_app_preferences_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or explicitly set one of Premiere's three documented AppPreference keys. Setting is a direct, non-undoable application-state change: copy the native string returned by inspect, choose persistence deliberately, confirm the change, and provide an operation_id for replay-safe dispatch. Competing writes to the same named preference serialize and are read back exactly.

tools.name: manage_clip_effects_uxp
tools.description: List native audio/video effects, inspect one clip's component chain, or add/remove one effect in a locked Premiere UXP transaction.

tools.name: manage_color_conformance_uxp
tools.description: Preflight project graphics-white/LUT/footage interpretation state, or update bounded footage-conformance fields in one undoable UXP transaction.

tools.name: manage_growing_media_uxp
tools.description: Inspect, pause under a bounded lease, or resume Premiere growing-media swaps. Pause expires within ten minutes and is resumed on ordinary panel or bridge shutdown; status is panel-local and never claims a host readback.

tools.name: manage_markers_uxp
tools.description: Inspect, add, update/move, remove, or explicitly review-then-remove a bounded marker batch by stable GUID using documented, undoable Premiere actions; mutations for one marker owner are serialized through preflight and readback.

tools.name: manage_media_watch
tools.description: Start, inspect, rescan, or stop one session-scoped local media-folder monitor. It records bounded file-change signals and never imports media automatically.

tools.name: manage_metadata_uxp
tools.description: Read bounded project/XMP metadata or update either form together in one locked, undoable Premiere transaction with readback evidence.

tools.name: manage_project_context
tools.description: Capture, enrich, import revision-bound editorial evidence, inspect, or clear a durable local Premiere project-context index. Capture stores bounded active-sequence/source metadata; local enrichment and evidence import add caller-approved transcripts, speaker labels, shots, audio observations, notes, or opaque frame references without re-analyzing media. Never include secrets or unrelated customer data.

tools.name: manage_project_panel_metadata_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or guardedly replace native Project-panel metadata. Update requires the exact inspected project GUID and XML, explicit confirmation, a replay key, local per-project serialization, and exact native readback; Premiere does not expose an atomic compare-and-set for this direct non-undoable setter.

tools.name: manage_project_sessions_uxp
tools.modes: list, validate, create, open, save, save_as, branch_copies, close
tools.description: List or explicitly create, open, save, branch, and close Premiere project sessions. Path writes stay inside the approved UXP workspace; Save As handle changes are read back and branch copies reopen the source after every copy.

tools.name: manage_proxies
tools.description: Create, attach, or toggle proxies for a project item. Note: 'create' only requests a proxy encode from Adobe Media Encoder and returns an unverified handoff. Independently verify the AME queue or output file before calling this tool again with action 'attach' and proxy_path set to the output_path you passed here. There is no single-call create-and-attach in Premiere's ExtendScript API.

tools.name: manage_proxy_ingest_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or attach proxy/high-resolution media for one clip, or read/update project ingest state. Attach operations are non-undoable and workspace-contained.

tools.name: manage_sequence_display_format_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or update a sequence's native audio/video time-display formats. Updates require the exact inspected sequence GUID and complete display-format snapshot, serialize competing updates per sequence, commit one undoable UXP transaction, and verify native readback. Cancellation is not supported after dispatch.

tools.name: manage_sequence_playhead_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or set the active sequence player position through documented Premiere UXP APIs. Setting requires the sequence GUID and current position returned by inspect, serializes competing requests for that sequence, and verifies native readback; it changes player state only and makes no project-save or Undo claim.

tools.name: manage_sequence_preview_frame_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or set one explicit sequence's documented preview-frame rectangle. Update requires the complete inspected snapshot, explicit confirmation, and an operation ID; it serializes preview-frame updates by reviewed project and sequence, commits one undoable settings transaction, then reads the same sequence back. It does not set sequence video dimensions, alter media or exports, prove rendered preview output, persistence, Undo behavior, or coordinate with Premiere UI or other extensions between native calls.

tools.name: manage_sequence_range_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or update the active sequence's in, out, and zero points through documented Premiere UXP actions. Updates require the complete inspect snapshot, run in one undoable transaction, and return native readback; a runtime capability probe remains authoritative.

tools.name: manage_sequence_settings_uxp
tools.description: Inspect sequence settings or apply a bounded settings profile in one documented, undoable UXP transaction with readback.

tools.name: manage_sequences_uxp
tools.modes: inspect, create_from_media, clone, subsequence, activate, open, close, delete
tools.description: Inspect, create-from-media, clone, derive, activate, open, close, or explicitly delete sequences through documented stable UXP APIs. Each action accepts only its own parameters: inspect takes none and lists every sequence; clone/subsequence/activate/open/close/delete take sequence_id; create_from_media takes name and project_item_ids.

tools.name: manage_source_clip_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or transactionally update source-clip in/out points and request scale-to-frame for up to 64 media items. In/out values are read back; Adobe exposes no getter for clear or scale state, so those requests remain committed-unverified.

tools.name: manage_source_media_overrides_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or transactionally set one source media item's explicit frame-rate and/or pixel-aspect-ratio override through stable Premiere 26.3 UXP actions. Updates require the complete effective-interpretation snapshot, explicit confirmation, an operation_id, per-item serialization, one undoable transaction, and native effective-value readback. Premiere does not expose an override-presence getter, so this tool cannot clear or distinguish an explicit override from matching file-native interpretation.

tools.name: manage_source_media_timing_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or transactionally set one source media item's timecode start through stable Premiere 26.3 UXP APIs. Setting requires the exact bounded timing snapshot, explicit confirmation, one undoable transaction, per-item serialization, and native readback.

tools.name: manage_timeline_selection_uxp
tools.modes: inspect, inspect_targets, replace, add, remove, clear
tools.description: Inspect, replace, add to, remove from, or clear the active sequence's native UXP clip selection with sequence and clip fingerprint stale-state guards.

tools.name: manage_timeline_source_label_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or set the documented source Project-item color label resolved from one active audio or video timeline coordinate. Update requires the complete reviewed snapshot, explicit confirmation, and an operation ID; it serializes color-label changes by source item, commits one undoable transaction, then re-reads the coordinate and source label. A source label is project-global: another use of the same source can reflect the change. It does not label a timeline-only instance, change clip timing, prove rendered appearance, playback, persistence, or Undo behavior.

tools.name: manage_track_state_uxp
tools.description: Inspect audio, video, and caption track mute state or set one media type serially with stale-state preflight and per-track readback. Adobe exposes this as direct promises, so no undo transaction is claimed.

tools.name: manage_workflow_checkpoints_uxp
tools.description: Read or transactionally write small, namespaced workflow checkpoints on the active project or a targeted sequence. Persistent values may sync with cloud projects; never store secrets, native paths, transcripts, or media names.

tools.name: match_frame
tools.description: Get source media info for the frame at the current playhead on a specific track. Useful for match frame operations.

tools.name: move_clip
tools.description: Move a clip to a new position on the timeline

tools.name: move_clip_to_track
tools.description: Move a clip to a different track. Uses QE DOM.

tools.name: move_item_to_bin
tools.description: Move a project item to a different bin

tools.name: move_items_to_bin
tools.description: Move multiple project items to a target bin at once.

tools.name: move_playhead_to_edit
tools.description: Move the playhead to the next or previous edit point.

tools.name: multiple_undo
tools.description: Unavailable: Premiere exposes no supported, observable undo-stack API for multiple scripted undo steps.

tools.name: mute_track
tools.description: Mute or unmute an audio track

tools.name: nest_clips
tools.description: Unavailable on the legacy CEP backend: Premiere's documented createSubsequence API only creates a separate sequence and cannot safely replace the selected timeline clips with a nested-sequence reference.

tools.name: normalize_loudness_file
tools.description: Create a new loudness-normalized media derivative with FFmpeg, then remeasure that exact output using EBU R128. Never overwrites the input or an existing output file.

tools.name: open_in_source
tools.description: Open a project item in the Source Monitor for preview and trimming.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a Premiere Pro project file

tools.name: organize_project_items_uxp
tools.modes: inspect_bin, create_bin, create_smart_bin, rename, move, set_color, remove
tools.description: Inspect a bin or transactionally create, rename, move, color-label, and remove project items with stable-ID guards.

tools.name: overwrite_clip
tools.description: Overwrite a project item onto validated timeline tracks and verify a new source placement at the requested time

tools.name: overwrite_from_source
tools.description: Overwrite the clip from the Source Monitor at the playhead position (overwrite edit — replaces existing clips).

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check — verify the CEP plugin is running and connected to Premiere Pro. Call this before other tools to confirm connectivity.

tools.name: plan_active_speaker_reframe
tools.description: Plan an active-speaker vertical reframe (Motion Scale/Position keyframes that follow whoever is talking) or a static stacked/split layout from a word timeline and static speaker regions. Returns framings, switches, keyframes, and apply routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_beat_montage
tools.description: Plan a beat-synced montage: carve a detect_beats grid into shots every N beats (merging short and splitting long spans), assign clips in order, and emit add_to_timeline_batch chunks, trim ranges, and cut markers. Local-only and deterministic; never changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_chapter_markers
tools.description: Plan YouTube-style chapters from a word-timed transcript using local TextTiling-lite topic-shift detection, titling each chapter from its distinctive tokens. Returns chapters, a youtube_timestamps block and add_marker-ready Chapter markers. Local-only plan; never changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_cross_app_workflow
tools.description: Plan an After Effects MOGRT or rendered-file handoff to Premiere using existing tools. Returns ordered dependencies, separate approvals, required evidence, and manual render stops. Local-only planning; never executes steps, issues approval tokens, or claims host readiness.

tools.name: plan_emphasis_zoom_keyframes
tools.description: Plan CapCut-style punch-in zoom keyframes (Motion Scale + subject-anchored Position) from a word timeline or supplied trigger times, with cooldown, easing, and hold controls. Local-only and deterministic; returns a keyframe plan for automate_effect_parameters_uxp or add_keyframe and never changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_filler_word_removal
tools.description: Plan word-level filler removal (um, uh, you know...) from a revision-bound word timeline. Returns frame-snapped removal and keep ranges plus apply routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_pause_tightening
tools.description: Plan shortening (not deleting) of inter-word pauses longer than max_pause_seconds down to a target, respecting sentence boundaries. Returns centered removal ranges, keep ranges, savings and apply routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_platform_delivery_matrix
tools.description: Plan multi-ratio delivery of one source sequence to TikTok, Reels, Shorts, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and Facebook from a local spec table: sequence settings, reframe scale math, duration and file-size fit, caption safe zones, and ordered apply routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_shot_match
tools.description: Compare two bounded local-media frame samples and return measured waveform/parade/saturation deltas plus coarse correction directions. Read-only planning only; it does not grade Premiere or claim that primaries alone can match the shots.

tools.name: plan_silence_review_markers
tools.description: Create a bounded, non-mutating review plan that maps FFmpeg-detected source-media silences onto one known 1x timeline placement. It clips candidates to the supplied source in/out span, redacts the source path, and never adds markers, cuts clips, or changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_speaker_checkerboard
tools.description: Plan a speaker checkerboard (each speaker's turns on their own video/audio track) from a caller-supplied word timeline. Returns frame-snapped segments, split points, track assignments, and the add_track/razor_all_tracks/move_clip_to_track routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

tools.name: plan_transcript_rough_cut_uxp
tools.description: Build a revision-locked, non-mutating rough-cut plan from Premiere's native transcript and verified 1x sequence placements. The plan orders cuts from the end of the timeline, requires a duplicate sequence, and requires re-query after every mutation.

tools.name: plan_word_mute_ranges
tools.description: Plan mute or bleep ranges for listed words/phrases in a word timeline. Returns redacted, frame-snapped mute ranges, ready-to-apply audio keyframes and (for bleep) tone placements. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

tools.name: play_source_monitor
tools.description: Request playback of the clip in the Source Monitor. The legacy API does not provide a same-call position readback, so movement is not reported as verified.

tools.name: play_timeline
tools.description: Request playback of the active sequence timeline through QE. The legacy API does not provide a same-call playhead readback, so movement is not reported as verified.

tools.name: preflight_production_storage_uxp
tools.description: Inspect project/Production scratch disks and ingest state, or set supported project scratch categories to Premiere's symbolic destinations in one undoable transaction.

tools.name: preview_after_effects_render
tools.description: Preview a bounded queue-only After Effects render request for one named composition and existing workspace output directory. It does not contact Adobe, enqueue, or render.

tools.name: preview_after_effects_render_handoff
tools.description: Preview import of one completed After Effects single-file render into an existing Premiere bin. Reads both connected hosts and binds approval to file metadata and project/bin identity. Does not render, import, or edit a timeline.

tools.name: preview_brand_spot
tools.description: Preview a brand-spot assembly from existing project items with an optional workspace-contained MOGRT overlay. Preview is local-only; it does not read or import the MOGRT file.

tools.name: preview_derived_dialogue_sequence_uxp
tools.description: Validate transcript revisions and preview a talking-head or speaker-reviewed podcast derivative. It creates nothing and returns an exact confirmation token.

tools.name: preview_edit_plan
tools.description: Validate and preview a compound timeline edit without changing Premiere. Returns a confirmation token required by apply_edit_plan.

tools.name: preview_editorial_plan
tools.description: Revalidate an exact server-issued editorial plan against the saved project-context revisions and return an opaque confirmation token. This tool is read-only and cannot apply the plan.

tools.name: preview_mogrt_batch
tools.description: Preview up to 20 bounded MOGRT recipe exports from a workspace-contained JSON or CSV data file. It does not contact Adobe or create any compositions or files.

tools.name: preview_mogrt_library_publish
tools.description: Preview a no-overwrite publish of a validated MOGRT into a workspace-contained, versioned local library. The library root must already exist; no file or directory is created during preview.

tools.name: preview_mogrt_premiere_handoff
tools.description: Preview a contained MOGRT import into one explicitly named disposable Premiere verification sequence and empty video track. It does not contact Premiere or alter a sequence.

tools.name: preview_mogrt_recipe
tools.modes: recipe: lower_third, title_card, callout, quote_card, social_end_card; frame_rate: 23.976, 24, 25, 29.97, 30, 50, 59.94, 60
tools.description: Preview a bounded After Effects MOGRT recipe from the supported title, callout, quote, and social template library. It validates one existing workspace output directory but does not contact Adobe or write any files.

tools.name: preview_motion_graphics_demo
tools.description: Preview a contained motion-graphics demo assembly from existing project items. It never creates demo assets, imports files, creates a sequence, or changes Premiere; apply requires an exact confirmation token.

tools.name: preview_product_spot
tools.description: Preview a product-spot assembly from existing project items. The eventual apply is limited to explicit empty tracks, revalidates item IDs, and reports host readback without claiming visual delivery verification.

tools.name: preview_project_intake
tools.description: Inspect a bounded Premiere project against an explicit facility intake template and return a path-redacted report plus a non-mutating organization proposal. It never changes Premiere or persists the template.

tools.name: preview_transcript_edit_uxp
tools.description: Validate and merge source-time ranges selected from Premiere's native transcript. Returns a confirmation token and never changes the timeline. Automatic timeline application remains withheld until the source-to-sequence mapping is live-host verified.

tools.name: preview_watched_media_import
tools.description: Compare the active watch baseline with a fresh contained scan and return a path-redacted import proposal. It never imports or changes Premiere.

tools.name: preview_workflow_recipe
tools.description: Validate and expand one declarative workflow recipe into guarded MCP routes. It does not invoke any route or change Premiere.

tools.name: publish_mogrt_to_library
tools.description: Publish the exact previewed MOGRT as an immutable local-library version. Requires explicit confirmation and will fail instead of replacing an existing version.

tools.name: rank_short_form_candidates
tools.description: Rank long-video transcript windows as short-form clip candidates using explainable local heuristics (hook, completeness, density, supplied evidence peaks, keywords, duration fit, speaker consistency) with overlap suppression. Local-only plan; not a virality prediction and never changes Premiere.

tools.name: razor_all_tracks
tools.description: Razor (split) all clips at the playhead position across all tracks, or at a specific time.

tools.name: read_sequence_captions
tools.description: Diagnose whether the active Premiere scripting host can enumerate caption tracks. It never treats an empty result as proof that the sequence has no captions, because most CEP builds expose caption creation but not caption reads.

tools.name: read_video_scopes
tools.description: Read waveform percentiles, RGB parade percentiles, saturation, and near-black/near-white RGB occupancy from one bounded decoded local-media frame. Read-only; this is a sampled analytical proxy, not Premiere's rendered scopes.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Unavailable: Premiere exposes no supported, observable redo-stack API, so a scripted redo cannot be performed or verified.

tools.name: refresh_media
tools.description: Refresh a project item to pick up changes to the source file

tools.name: relink_media
tools.description: Relink an offline media item to a new file path

tools.name: relink_offline_media_uxp
tools.description: Relink one offline clip to a workspace-contained media path after stale-path and capability checks. This Premiere API is non-undoable and requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: remove_all_effects
tools.description: Remove ALL effects from a clip. Uses QE DOM.

tools.name: remove_effect
tools.description: Remove an effect from a clip by its index or name. Returns a capability error when the host cannot remove an individual component.

tools.name: remove_effect_by_name
tools.description: Remove all instances of a specific effect from a clip by display name. Returns a capability error when the host cannot remove individual components.

tools.name: remove_from_timeline
tools.description: Remove a clip from the timeline

tools.name: remove_keyframe
tools.description: Remove a keyframe at a specific time from an effect property

tools.name: remove_keyframe_range
tools.description: Remove all keyframes in a time range from an effect property

tools.name: remove_selected_clips
tools.description: Remove all currently selected clips from the timeline.

tools.name: remove_video_transition_uxp
tools.description: Remove one unchanged native video-transition edge through one undoable UXP transaction. Requires an exact inspect snapshot, serializes transition updates per sequence, and reads edge absence back; it does not prove rendered appearance or playback.

tools.name: rename_bin
tools.description: Rename a bin (folder) in the project panel

tools.name: rename_clip
tools.description: Rename a clip on the timeline. Uses QE DOM.

tools.name: rename_project_item
tools.description: Rename a project item in the project panel.

tools.name: rename_track
tools.description: Rename a video or audio track.

tools.name: rename_track_uxp
tools.description: Rename an audio, video, or caption track through Premiere 26.3+ UXP in an undoable transaction with name readback verification.

tools.name: replace_clip
tools.description: Replace a clip on the timeline with a different project item, preserving position and duration

tools.name: replace_clip_media
tools.description: Unavailable by design: the legacy ExtendScript overwrite route cannot prove that replacing media preserves the original clip's trim, position, linked audio, or adjacent clips, so this tool performs no mutation.

tools.name: reverse_clip
tools.description: Unavailable: Premiere does not expose a supported scripting API for reversing a timeline clip's playback direction.

tools.name: ripple_delete
tools.description: Ripple delete a clip (removes clip and closes the gap). Uses QE DOM.

tools.name: ripple_delete_track_item_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or perform one guarded ripple delete on an audio or video timeline item using documented UXP SequenceEditor actions. Apply requires complete target and contiguous-successor snapshots, explicit confirmation, and an operation ID; it serializes with guarded slips, slides, and append duplicates on that track, commits one transaction, and reads back the successor at the removed coordinate. It intentionally cannot ripple a final item, a gap, another track, or a linked A/V pair. It does not prove media handles, linked A/V synchronization, rendered frames, playback, persistence, or Undo behavior.

tools.name: roll_edit
tools.description: Perform a verified roll edit at the outgoing cut of a clip using the public timeline DOM, moving both visible edges and their source in/out points and verifying all four.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the current Premiere Pro project

tools.name: save_project_as
tools.description: Save the current project to a new location

tools.name: save_project_uxp
tools.description: Save the active project through UXP and require Premiere to confirm success.

tools.name: scene_edit_detection
tools.description: Perform scene edit detection on the selected clips in the active sequence. Defaults to creating markers rather than cutting.

tools.name: search_clip_transcript_uxp
tools.description: Search Premiere's native transcript JSON without modifying the clip or timeline.

tools.name: search_project_context
tools.description: Search a durable Premiere project-context index for relevant sources, timeline placements, transcript passages, shots, audio observations, and notes. Returns bounded evidence with stable IDs and revisions; it never changes Premiere.

tools.name: search_project_items
tools.description: Search for project items by name, media file extension, offline status, or color label. Returns matching items with full details.

tools.name: search_workflow_recipes
tools.description: Search audited built-in and explicitly supplied workspace-local workflow recipes. Recipes are declarative previews and cannot execute arbitrary tools or scripts.

tools.name: select_all_clips
tools.description: Select all clips in the active sequence, or all clips on a specific track.

tools.name: select_clips_by_color
tools.description: Select all clips whose source project item has a specific color label.

tools.name: select_clips_by_name
tools.description: Select all clips in the active sequence that match a name (substring match). Optionally filter by track type and index.

tools.name: select_clips_in_range
tools.description: Select all clips that overlap a time range in the active sequence.

tools.name: select_disabled_clips
tools.description: Select all disabled clips in the active sequence.

tools.name: select_item
tools.description: Select a project item in the Project panel

tools.name: set_active_sequence
tools.description: Set the active sequence by name or ID

tools.name: set_all_tracks_targeted
tools.description: Set all tracks targeted or untargeted. Useful before insert/overwrite edits.

tools.name: set_anti_alias_quality
tools.description: Set the anti-alias quality on a clip's Motion effect (useful for scaled/rotated clips).

tools.name: set_blend_mode
tools.modes: blend_mode: Normal, Dissolve, Darken, Multiply, Color Burn, Linear Burn, Darker Color, Lighten, Screen, Color Dodge, Linear Dodge, Lighter Color, Overlay, Soft Light, Hard Light, Vivid Light, Linear Light, Pin Light, Hard Mix, Difference, Exclusion, Subtract, Divide, Hue, Saturation, Color, Luminosity
tools.description: Set the blend mode on a video clip. Uses the Opacity effect's Blend Mode property.

tools.name: set_clip_anchor_point
tools.description: Set the Anchor Point property on a video clip's Motion effect.

tools.name: set_clip_opacity
tools.description: Set the opacity of a video clip (0-100).

tools.name: set_clip_pan
tools.description: Set and read back the pan (left/right balance) on an audio clip, including Channel Volume layouts.

tools.name: set_clip_position
tools.description: Set the Position property on a video clip's Motion effect. Values are in pixels.

tools.name: set_clip_properties
tools.description: Set supported clip properties (opacity, scale, position, rotation). Clip speed is unsupported and fails before mutation.

tools.name: set_clip_properties_batch
tools.description: Apply Motion/Opacity values to up to 16 clips after preflighting every target property. The handler reads each requested value back and never reports a partial batch as verified.

tools.name: set_clip_rotation
tools.description: Set the Rotation property on a video clip's Motion effect.

tools.name: set_clip_scale
tools.description: Set the Scale property on a video clip's Motion effect.

tools.name: set_clip_selection
tools.description: Select or deselect a clip in the active sequence

tools.name: set_clip_speed_qe
tools.description: Unavailable: Premiere does not expose a supported scripting API for changing a timeline clip's speed.

tools.name: set_clip_start_time
tools.description: Set the start time (timecode offset) of a project item. This shifts where timecode begins for the source media.

tools.name: set_clip_volume
tools.description: Set an audio clip's Volume > Level in dB. Does not read or change Essential Sound Amplify automation.

tools.name: set_clips_volume
tools.description: Set the volume (in dB) on every audio clip of a track, or on a list of clip indices. One round trip instead of one call per clip - essential for sequences with dozens of clips.

tools.name: set_color_label
tools.description: Set the color label on a project item or clip

tools.name: set_color_value
tools.description: Set a color value on an effect property (e.g., tint color, fill color)

tools.name: set_effect_property
tools.description: Set the value of a specific effect property on a clip. Accepts scalar, boolean, string, and array-shaped vector values (for example Motion > Position as [x, y]) and verifies the readback component by component.

tools.name: set_footage_interpretation
tools.description: Set footage interpretation settings for a project item

tools.name: set_frame_blend
tools.description: Enable or disable frame blending on a clip. Uses QE DOM.

tools.name: set_graphics_white_luminance
tools.description: Set the graphics white luminance value (HDR setting) for the project

tools.name: set_item_in_out
tools.description: Set in and/or out points on a project item in the project panel (marks source range for editing).

tools.name: set_keyframe_interpolation
tools.description: Set the interpolation type of a keyframe (Linear, Hold, or Bezier)

tools.name: set_metadata
tools.description: Replace project metadata XML on a project item and verify the exact readback. Partial field/value writes are intentionally rejected because Premiere requires a complete Project Metadata XML payload.

tools.name: set_offline
tools.description: Set a project item offline, or ask Premiere to refresh it back online when offline is false.

tools.name: set_override_frame_rate
tools.description: Override the frame rate of a project item (useful for image sequences or misinterpreted media)

tools.name: set_override_pixel_aspect_ratio
tools.description: Override the pixel aspect ratio of a project item

tools.name: set_playhead_position
tools.description: Set the playhead (CTI) position in the active sequence

tools.name: set_poster_frame
tools.description: Set the poster frame (thumbnail) for a project item at a specific time.

tools.name: set_project_item_audio_channel_mapping
tools.description: Map one output audio channel of a project item to a source channel using Premiere's documented AudioChannelMapping API.

tools.name: set_project_panel_metadata
tools.description: Set the project panel metadata/column configuration from XML and verify that Premiere reads back the exact XML

tools.name: set_project_scratch_disk
tools.description: Set the project's scratch disk paths for captured video, audio, and previews.

tools.name: set_scale_to_frame_size
tools.description: Enable 'Scale to Frame Size' on a project item so it fills the sequence frame

tools.name: set_scale_width_height
tools.description: Set independent Scale Width and Scale Height on a clip (requires Uniform Scale to be OFF).

tools.name: set_scratch_disk_path
tools.description: Set the scratch disk path for a specific media type

tools.name: set_sequence_audio_settings
tools.description: Change audio settings of the active sequence (sample rate, channel type).

tools.name: set_sequence_display_format
tools.description: Set the timecode display format for the active sequence.

tools.name: set_sequence_field_type
tools.description: Set the field order of the active sequence.

tools.name: set_sequence_frame_rate
tools.description: Change the frame rate of the active sequence.

tools.name: set_sequence_in_out_points
tools.description: Set the sequence in and out points (for export range, etc.)

tools.name: set_sequence_pixel_aspect_ratio
tools.description: Change the pixel aspect ratio of the active sequence, or return a capability error when the legacy host does not expose a writable setting.

tools.name: set_sequence_resolution
tools.description: Change the resolution (frame size) of the active sequence.

tools.name: set_sequence_settings
tools.description: Modify and read back sequence frame-size settings.

tools.name: set_source_in_out
tools.description: Set in and/or out points on the clip currently open in the Source Monitor.

tools.name: set_source_monitor_position_uxp
tools.description: Set and read back the Source Monitor position using Premiere 26.3+ UXP.

tools.name: set_start_time
tools.description: Set the start time (timecode offset) for a project item

tools.name: set_target_track
tools.description: Set a track as targeted (active for insert/overwrite edits). Only one video and one audio track can be targeted at a time.

tools.name: set_time_interpolation
tools.description: Set time interpolation type for a clip (Frame Sampling, Frame Blending, Optical Flow). Uses QE DOM.

tools.name: set_transcode_on_ingest
tools.description: Enable or disable transcoding on ingest for the project

tools.name: set_uniform_scale
tools.description: Toggle uniform scale on a clip's Motion effect. When enabled, Scale Width and Scale Height are linked.

tools.name: set_work_area
tools.description: Set the work area (bar) in and out points

tools.name: set_workspace
tools.description: Switch to a specific workspace layout (e.g., 'Editing', 'Color', 'Audio', 'Effects', 'Graphics')

tools.name: set_xmp_metadata
tools.description: Merge a raw XMP XML patch into a project item's existing XMP metadata without removing unrelated fields.

tools.name: set_zero_point
tools.description: Set the starting timecode (zero point) of a sequence

tools.name: setup_ducking
tools.description: Build a verified Volume > Level keyframe curve for one audio clip. Ducking-window times are relative to that clip's start; overlapping or out-of-range windows are rejected before any keyframe write.

tools.name: slide_edit
tools.description: Perform a verified slide edit on a clip using adjacent clips from the public timeline DOM.

tools.name: slide_track_item_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or perform one guarded slide on an audio or video timeline item using documented UXP track-item actions. Apply requires the complete three-item snapshot, explicit confirmation, and an operation ID; it serializes slides and source-only slips on the affected track, commits one transaction, and verifies every affected source and timeline boundary. Only contiguous forward 1x clips are supported. It does not prove source handles, linked A/V synchronization, rendered frames, playback, persistence, or Undo behavior.

tools.name: slip_edit
tools.description: Perform a verified slip edit on a clip using public source in/out properties.

tools.name: slip_track_item_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or perform one guarded source-only slip on an audio or video timeline item. Apply requires the complete inspected snapshot, explicit confirmation, and an operation ID; it serializes slip operations per target, creates the documented source in/out actions in one undoable transaction, and reads back unchanged timeline timing plus the exact shifted source range. It supports only forward 1x clips, does not infer available media handles, and does not prove rendered frames, playback, linked-item sync, persistence, or Undo behavior.

tools.name: speed_change
tools.description: Unavailable: Premiere does not expose a supported scripting API for changing a timeline clip's speed.

tools.name: split_clip
tools.description: Split every clip on one track that spans a timeline time, then verify both resulting boundaries. Requires QE DOM; effect-keyframe redistribution remains unverified.

tools.name: stabilize_clip
tools.modes: method: Subspace Warp, Position, Position, Scale, Rotation
tools.description: Apply the Warp Stabilizer effect to a clip for video stabilization. Uses QE DOM.

tools.name: start_batch_encode
tools.description: Request Adobe Media Encoder to start the render queue; reports only accepted handoff, not queue progress or output-file creation.

tools.name: stop_playback
tools.description: Request that active-sequence timeline playback stop through QE. The legacy API does not provide a same-call playhead readback, so stopped state is not reported as verified.

tools.name: toggle_track_visibility
tools.description: Toggle a video track's visibility (eye icon)

tools.name: transform_track_item_uxp
tools.description: Inspect or atomically move, trim, rename, and enable/disable one audio or video track item with stale-position guards and readback.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.description: Trim exactly one source in/out point and verify the corresponding visible timeline edge. Refuses retimed clips and, by default, trims that would leave effect keyframes outside the visible clip.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Unavailable: Premiere exposes no supported, observable undo-stack API, so a scripted undo cannot be performed or verified.

tools.name: unlink_selection
tools.description: Unlink the currently selected video and audio clips in the active sequence

tools.name: unnest_sequence
tools.description: Unnest a nested sequence on the timeline, replacing it with the contents of the nested sequence

tools.name: update_marker
tools.description: Update an existing marker's properties

tools.name: validate_cmx3600_edl
tools.description: Validate a local CMX 3600 EDL's supported event grammar, timecodes, durations, duplicate event IDs, record overlaps, and record gaps before user-assisted Premiere interchange.

tools.name: validate_export_preset
tools.description: Validate that an Adobe Media Encoder .epr preset exists and ask the active Premiere sequence which output extension it produces

tools.name: validate_mogrt_brand_kit
tools.description: Validate an operator-approved local MOGRT brand kit before using it in a template or batch preview. It never reads font inventories, image pixels, or writes files.

tools.name: validate_platform_publish_package
tools.modes: platform: tiktok, instagram_reels, instagram_feed, instagram_story, youtube_shorts, youtube, linkedin, x, facebook_reels
tools.description: Validate a rendered file plus title, description, hashtags, and content flags against one platform's approximate 2026 publish limits. Returns hard violations, soft warnings, normalized hashtags, and character counts. Local-only; never uploads or changes Premiere.

tools.name: validate_project_for_export
tools.description: Run a non-mutating export readiness audit for an active or named sequence. It reports blocking offline media, empty timelines, inaccessible preset/output paths, duration, and optional timeline gaps without queuing an export.

tools.name: verify_after_effects_connection
tools.description: Read-only check that the dedicated After Effects CEP connector is running. It never reads project names, media, or paths.

tools.name: verify_delivery_conformance
tools.description: Verify a local exported file against an explicit delivery contract using ffprobe and optional EBU R128 analysis. Returns pass, fail, or not_evaluated per check; it does not prove Premiere render lineage or visual approval.

tools.name: verify_delivery_file
tools.description: Verify that an exported delivery is a non-empty regular file and calculate a SHA-256 or SHA-512 checksum; optionally compare expected size and checksum

tools.name: verify_fcpxml_media_references
tools.description: Verify FCPXML file:// media references only inside caller-approved existing roots. References outside those roots are never statted or exposed as local paths.

tools.name: verify_mogrt_artifact
tools.description: Verify that a workspace-contained .mogrt artifact exists locally and has a ZIP header. This does not prove controls, import compatibility, playback, or visual correctness.

tools.name: verify_premiere_connection
tools.description: Run a safe, read-only first-run check. It proves that this MCP server, the selected Premiere bridge, an active project, and an active sequence are connected without returning project names, paths, or media details.

tools.name: wait_for_host_readiness_uxp
tools.description: Capture a pre-dispatch readiness revision or wait, without retrying, for video-effect analysis or one documented operation-completion receipt.
